# Plugins

Built from [source commit a5ac9496c3e6262bc39dd4a0e7bc014e57da3353](https://github.com/XxUnkn0wnxX/Zerthox-BetterDiscord-Plugins/tree/a5ac9496c3e6262bc39dd4a0e7bc014e57da3353).

- [BetterFolders](./BetterFolders.plugin.js) — v3.8.1: Adds new functionality to server folders. Custom Folder Icons. Close other folders on open.
- [BetterVolume](./BetterVolume.plugin.js) — v3.2.4: Set user volume values manually instead of using a slider. Allows setting volumes higher than 200%.
- [CollapseEmbeds](./CollapseEmbeds.plugin.js) — v2.2.1: Adds a button to collapse embeds & attachments.
- [DevTools](./DevTools.plugin.js) — v0.5.3: Utilities for development.
- [Emulator](./Emulator.plugin.js) — v2.0.0: Emulate Windows, MacOS, Linux or Browser on any platform. WARNING: Emulating a different platform may cause unwanted side effects. Use at own risk.
- [NoReplyMention](./NoReplyMention.plugin.js) — v0.2.4: Suppresses reply mentions.
- [OnlineFriendCount](./OnlineFriendCount.plugin.js) — v3.3.2: Adds the old online friend count and similar counters back to server list. Because nostalgia.
- [SVGInspect](./SVGInspect.plugin.js) — v0.1.4: View all SVG components bundled in Discord
- [VoiceEvents](./VoiceEvents.plugin.js) — v2.8.6: Adds TTS Event Notifications to your selected Voice Channel. TeamSpeak feeling.
